description: Adds the optional closed task-identity policy declaration and shared resolver guidance while preserving opaque mode when no declaration exists.
delta: Lean Delivery and Governed SDD identify .meridian/task-identity.json as the sole optional identity declaration and state that absence selects opaque mode. The migration never creates that project-owned file or rewrites task and queue identities.
verification: both workflow templates carry task-identity-policy v1
upgrade planning changes only managed workflow guidance and never creates .meridian/task-identity.json
resolver and CLI tests cover opaque compatibility, milestone identities, ambiguity, collisions, malformed declarations, and exit codes
